content: Dear Customer, please complete your mandatory re-KYC at your nearest SBI home branch before March 31 with original PAN and Aadhaar card. Do not submit details on any third-party link.

content: Google Pay: You have received a cashback reward of Rs 25 for your merchant payment. Credited directly to your linked HDFC account.
